operators.operator: Local Redevelopment Authority for Roosevelt Roads
operators.system_scope: Former Naval Station Roosevelt Roads sanitary sewer system
operators.reason: A current LRA procurement establishes LRA ownership/operator responsibility for the sanitary system and the USDA project enumerates five lift stations for rehabilitation. LRA's 2025 Q&A states existing sanitary discharges were being removed by vacuum trucks to PRASA and no active WWTP was operating, so the five rehabilitation assets are not promoted to current operational stations.

operators.system_scope: Palmas del Mar sanitary sewer collection and wastewater treatment system
operators.current_source_claim: PDMU currently states that it operates the sanitary sewer system and a wastewater treatment plant with five pumping stations that collect and transport effluent within Palmas del Mar.
operators.named_station_identity_source: PDMU presentation preserved in public technical proceedings
operators.identity_caveat: The current official site certifies a five-station denominator but does not individually restate the station labels. The 2022 source supplies the five labels; continuity of each label is retained as a candidate binding rather than independent current identity proof.

operators.system_scope: Coco Beach / Grand Reserve wastewater system

same_name_exclusion.name: Coco Beach Pumping Station
same_name_exclusion.reason: The recovered 2015 AAA geodatabase and current SIGE environmental layer bind a separate PRASA-owned Coco Beach pumping station at the same source coordinate. It is excluded from the private Coco Beach Utility denominator.

operators.franchise_snapshot: 2024 law states sewer/water franchise expiration in 2025
operators.historical_pump_station_design_manifesta: Wastewater Pumping Station for Caguas Real Development, 2001
operators.reason: Current public-water-system evidence does not establish current sewer operation. No authoritative post-2025 franchise-renewal instrument or current sewer pump-station inventory was recovered in the bounded search.

arithmetic.reason: Only PDMU currently provides both current operator scope and an explicit current pump-station count. The other operator branches have unresolved current station status or count.

aaa_combination_gate.reason: The requested combination requires a certified current AAA denominator. The June 2024 reported count of 835 cannot be promoted to August 2026 current status.

pr_wide_closure.reason: Current non-AAA sanitary operators are proven, but the exact current non-AAA EBAS denominator and the exact current AAA denominator are both incomplete.
